source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Flat, front-on decorative panel of syncretic Dasri Bedouin Al-Sadu coarse goat-hair weave fused with Chiricahua Apache lightning-chevrons and ibex horns: horizontal warp-faced woollen bands in jet goat-hair black (#141210), Socotran dragon's-blood crimson (#8c1916), sun-bleached juss chalk (#eae5da), woad indigo (#162447), and rabbitbrush gold (#c99322), featuring four symmetrical swept ibex-horn pairs across framed by Apache stepped lightning diamonds and tiny turquoise seed-bead (#248f8a) borders, exact seam alignment. Full colour.
